gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-amulya: Loose and handmade: Kavivanar draws with one unvarying stroke and flaring s endings, while Amulya keeps its curves generously open and modern. Handwriting up top, tidy text below, nice for a quick skim.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-neco: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Kavivanar flares its lowercase s and leaves its joins heavy, a loose hand over a dignified serif. Neco does best at a modest size, since it is not built for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-plein: Friendly and loose, Kavivanar draws a steady unshaded outline and flares the ends of its lowercase s. Plein keeps a clear channel into each round letter, good for light, occasional reading.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-recia: Kavivanar is hand-drawn and relaxed, its bowls as weighty as its stems and its s flaring open at the ends. Recia is the sharper one, its gentle weight shifts better suited to brief text.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-synonym: Kavivanar writes loosely, one unbroken stroke from top to baseline, with a flaring lowercase s. Synonym keeps ink uniform and curves generous, a dependable anchor for the loose hand above, built for quick glances.
gen-gf-kavivanar-outfit: Outfit bends its curves like cable, no swelling or thinning, and stops each one well before it closes. And Kavivanar adds a loose, hand-drawn smile with its flaring lowercase s, ideal for quick reads.
gen-gf-kavivanar-plus-jakarta-sans: A flaring lowercase s gives Kavivanar its friendly, hand-drawn look, one steady stroke from top to baseline. Plus Jakarta Sans counters with monoline precision and well-spaced curve endings, better with brief text.
gen-gf-kavivanar-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without pressure swell, pleasant for a quick read. And Kavivanar, relaxed with a flaring s, is happiest in a few oversized words.
gen-gf-kelly-slab-fs-rowan: Kelly Slab is bold and commanding, its big open eyes staring out of every e and a. Rowan answers softly, its thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones, suited to brief bits of text.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-neco: Klee One writes with a casual, friendly pen, terminals cut short. Neco brings a measured swell from hairline to stem, and across the page it feels authoritative, never pinched shut, ideal for brief text.
